task_groups.title: Implement agentfox/io/errors.py — error envelope and routing

subtasks.title: Implement error_envelope() with full exception type mapping
details: Create agentfox/io/errors.py
Implement lazy import guard for agentspec: try/except ImportError setting _AGENTSPEC_AVAILABLE flag
Implement snake_case conversion function for class names (CamelCase → snake_case) using re.sub or str manipulation

Implement error_envelope(exc, *, state=None) -> dict: AgentFoxError subclasses use snake_case class name and per-class retryable; AgentError uses .category if present else 'agent_error'; SessionError always session_error/False; click.ClickException → input_error/False; unknown → internal_error/False + detail field
Omit 'detail' key for well-typed exceptions; include only for internal_error fallback
Include top-level 'state' key only when state is non-None
When agentspec not installed, agentspec exception types fall through to internal_error (no ImportError at module load)

subtasks.title: Implement cli_error_handler() and handle_cli_errors decorator
details: Implement cli_error_handler(ctx, exc): checks json_mode from OutputManager (ctx.obj['output'] or get_output_manager()); if json_mode=True calls emit_error(exc); if json_mode=False calls click.echo(str(exc), err=True)
Implement handle_cli_errors as a no-argument decorator (@handle_cli_errors without parentheses)
Decorator catches Exception (not SystemExit or KeyboardInterrupt); resolves json_mode dynamically via get_output_manager() at call time; delegates to cli_error_handler()
Do NOT re-export handle_cli_errors from agentfox/io/__init__.py — it is internal only

subtasks.title: Implement AgentSpecError mapping and edge case handling
details: AgentSpecError subclasses AgentError and carries .category attribute — apply same .category-first mapping logic as AgentError
When agentspec is not installed, any exception falling through to internal_error still produces a valid envelope with detail=class name
Guard all agentspec isinstance checks behind _AGENTSPEC_AVAILABLE flag to prevent NameError when package absent

subtasks.title: Verify errors.py implementation passes all error-related tests
Implement emit(), emit_line(), and emit_ok() functions
details: Create agentfox/io/json.py
Implement emit(data: dict) -> None: json.dumps(data, indent=2, default=str) written to sys.stdout; wrap write in try/except BrokenPipeError: pass
Implement emit_line(data: dict) -> None: json.dumps(data, default=str) compact (no indent) written to sys.stdout with newline; wrap in try/except BrokenPipeError: pass
Implement emit_ok(data: dict) -> None: always overwrites 'ok' key with True before calling emit(); caller-supplied 'ok' is silently ignored
All three functions suppress BrokenPipeError silently

subtasks.title: Implement emit_error() and read_stdin()
details: Implement emit_error(exc: Exception, *, state: str | None = None) -> None: calls error_envelope(exc, state=state) from errors.py to build dict; always writes to sys.stdout regardless of json_mode; wraps in try/except BrokenPipeError: pass

Implement read_stdin() -> dict: if sys.stdin.isatty() return {}; read sys.stdin with UTF-8 encoding until EOF; if empty return {}; parse JSON and return dict; raises json.JSONDecodeError for malformed JSON; raises UnicodeDecodeError for non-UTF-8 bytes; no timeout
No circular import: json.py imports error_envelope from errors.py; errors.py must not import from json.py

subtasks.title: Verify json.py implementation passes all serialization tests
Implement OutputManager class with all fields and format dispatch methods
details: Create agentfox/io/output.py
Define OutputManager dataclass or class with fields: json_mode: bool, quiet: bool, verbose: bool, trace: bool, console: Console (Rich Console for stderr)
Implement emit_json(data: dict) -> None: writes JSON (indent=2) to stdout iff json_mode=True; silently no-ops otherwise
Implement emit_human(text: str) -> None: writes plain text to stdout iff json_mode=False; silently no-ops otherwise

Implement emit(data: dict, human_fn: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> None: calls emit_json if json_mode=True; calls human_fn() if json_mode=False and human_fn is provided; silently no-ops if json_mode=False and human_fn is None
Implement banner() -> None: renders themed banner to stderr; suppressed when json_mode=True OR quiet=True
Implement status(message: str) -> None: writes to stderr; suppressed when quiet=True

subtasks.title: Implement get_output_manager() convenience accessor
details: Implement get_output_manager() -> OutputManager: tries click.get_current_context() to read ctx.obj['output']; if no context or key absent, returns fallback OutputManager(json_mode=False, quiet=False, verbose=False, trace=False)
AF_AGENT env var is NOT consulted in the fallback path — fallback is strictly for non-CLI contexts
Fallback OutputManager always returns the four fixed defaults regardless of environment variables

Implement StatusSpinner context manager with TTY/non-TTY/quiet modes
details: Create agentfox/io/spinner.py
Implement StatusSpinner(message: str, *, quiet: bool = False, theme: AppTheme | None = None) with lazy import of AppTheme from agentfox.ui.display
Implement __enter__/__exit__: in quiet mode, all methods are no-ops; in TTY mode, start Rich Live with 'dots' spinner style on stderr; in non-TTY mode, do not start animation

Implement update(message: str): in TTY mode updates spinner message via Live; in non-TTY mode prints plain text line to stderr using theme.console.print(message) or fallback Console(stderr=True).print(message); no-op in quiet mode
Implement log(message: str): in TTY mode prints persistent line through Rich Live; in non-TTY mode prints plain text line to stderr using theme.console or fallback Console; no-op in quiet mode
When theme=None, always fall back to Console(stderr=True) with no styling for all output

subtasks.title: Trace all eight execution paths end-to-end
details: PATH-1 (agent mode AF_AGENT=1): verify AgentFoxGroup.invoke() → OutputManager(json_mode=True, quiet=True) → emit_ok() → stdout JSON (TS-03-SMOKE-1)
PATH-2 (JSON error envelope): verify AgentFoxGroup catches Exception → cli_error_handler → emit_error → error_envelope → stdout JSON → sys.exit(1) (TS-03-SMOKE-2)

PATH-6 (read_stdin piped): verify sys.stdin.isatty()==False → read until EOF → parse JSON → return dict (TS-03-SMOKE-6)
PATH-7 (--version eager): verify click processes --version before invoke completes → callback uses click.echo() → SystemExit(0) propagates (TS-03-SMOKE-7)
PATH-8 (emit_error with state): verify emit_error(exc, state='executing') → error_envelope(state='executing') → JSON with top-level 'state' field (TS-03-SMOKE-8)
